Features

Network monitoring features that turn traffic into answers

Collect NetFlow, sFlow and IPFIX, record packets at up to 100 Gbit, recognise 450+ applications and ask an on-prem AI analyst what happened. Every feature runs on your own infrastructure.

Download ntopng free
Compare editions

Core features

Everything you need to see, record and understand traffic

NetFlow, sFlow and IPFIX collection

Collect flows from routers, switches and firewalls, or generate them from a mirror port or TAP.

Traffic recording

Record every packet to disk with n2disk, index it on the fly and pull the exact packets when an incident happens.

Application visibility (DPI)

See Teams, Netflix and TLS-encrypted apps, not just port 443, with 450+ protocols detected by nDPI.

AI network analysis

Ask questions in plain language and get charts, root causes and an evidence log, without sending data to the cloud.

High-speed packet capture

PF_RING and Cento keep up with 10 to 100 Gbit links on commodity hardware.

Alerts and threat detection

Behavioral checks flag scans, suspicious hosts and risky flows, with drill-down from alert to flow to packets.

Use cases that pay for themselves

Prove what caused the slowdown

Flows show who and when, recorded packets show exactly what. End the blame game between network and application teams.

Troubleshooting guide

See who uses your bandwidth

Top talkers, applications and countries in real time, so you stop guessing and start deciding.

Network visibility

Detect threats you cannot see in logs

Scans, beaconing and suspicious TLS fingerprints show up in traffic even when endpoints stay silent.

Threat detection

Keep sensitive data in-house

Self-hosted and open source. No cloud account and no traffic sent to a third party, including the AI assistant.

Open source monitoring

Monitor ISP and carrier networks

Collect flows from many routers, track ASNs and exporters, and defend against DDoS.

ISP solutions

Plan capacity with real data

Historical flows and timeseries show growth by link, application and site before users complain.

Flow analytics

Architecture

How the pieces fit together

1. Capture

Packets from a mirror port or TAP, or flows from your routers. PF_RING and Cento handle the high speeds.

2. Analyze

nProbe turns packets into flows, nDPI labels every application, and ntopng shows hosts, flows and alerts.

3. Record and ask

n2disk keeps the packets as proof, and nAnalyst answers questions about everything it sees.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What features does ntopng include for free?

The Community edition includes real-time visibility and top talkers, Layer-7 application detection with nDPI, alerts, timeseries and network discovery. It is open source under GPLv3.

Do I need all the ntop products?

No. Start with ntopng alone. Add nProbe when your routers export NetFlow, n2disk when you need recorded packets, and nAnalyst when you want AI-assisted investigation.

Does my traffic leave my network?

No. ntop software is self-hosted and the nAnalyst AI assistant is designed to run on-premises.

Can it handle high-speed networks?

Yes. With PF_RING and nProbe Cento, ntopng analyzes traffic on 10 to 100 Gbit links, and n2disk can record up to 100 Gbit.

Get started

Try it on your own network

Download the free Community edition of ntopng, or talk to the ntop team about your requirements.

Download free
Talk to the team
